scope: Actual built frontend with explicitly simulated session, organization APIs and IdP page; no real signup, MFA, organization or provider connection tested.

checks.name: No signup action is invented when server signup capability is false
Signup uses IdP rather than a local password or OTP form
Signup and login controls fit a 320px viewport
Signup sends its explicit intent to the same-origin broker
FHD organization choice remains a readable focused page
No bootstrap, dossiers, members or messages are requested before organization choice
Join errors preserve the available choice and never display raw provider details
Real organization request waits for an administrator without loading business data
A returned session for a different account cannot load any dossier
Test organization opens only after verified session refresh and does not replay join
Test membership does not gain an administrator-only project creation action
No JavaScript error or real identity-provider traffic
